input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue occurs because the reset password email uses the BASE_URL constant which defaults to "http://localhost:3000" when the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes the email links to point to localhost, which won't work for external users.

To fix this, the deployment environment should set the PUBLIC_URL environment variable to the correct public-facing URL of the application. This will ensure that password reset links in emails use the proper domain instead of localhost.

File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email uses the BASE_URL constant that falls back to "http://localhost:3000" when process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes reset links in emails to point to localhost, which is incorrect for deployed environments.

Proposed change: Adjust the way BASE_URL is set or ensure process.env.PUBLIC_URL is properly set in the deployment so that the reset-password link in the email uses the correct public URL instead of localhost.
